notes: Both circuits (sender and receiver) are combined in one graph; they are physically separate and share no electrical connection.

The MKR WAN 1300 is not in the catalogue, so a new type was created (ports read from the diagram pin labels; DAC0/A0 is named A0). USB and ANT (u.FL antenna connector) are modelled as header-socket ports.
The antenna is a new type 'lora-antenna'; it connects to the board's u.FL connector via its cable.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: rows f-j (top half of the picture) are bank 'b', so e.g. column 5 row g is '5b.g'. Columns were estimated from the image: sender button legs in columns 5 and 7 (row g), wires in 5f and 7f; receiver LED cathode column 6 and anode (bent leg) column 8 on row h, resistor from 8g to 11g, GND wire at 6g, pin 2 wire at 11f.
Pushbutton: only two legs are shown on the breadboard, on opposite sides; they are mapped to ports 1.l and 2.r. The exact pin pairing is an assumption.
The resistor value is not stated in the manual; 220 ohm assumed (typical for an LED).
The LED's straight leg is taken as cathode (to GND) and its bent leg as anode (via the resistor to pin 2), consistent with the sketch driving pin 2 HIGH.
Sender button uses INPUT_PULLUP on pin 2, so no external resistor or power connection is needed. Laptops for the USB cables are not shown in the manual and are omitted.
